map.客厅按推荐照度估算主灯总光通量，反推需要几只 800lm 筒灯或选多大光通的吸顶: Estimate the main lamp total luminous flux for a living room by recommended illuminance, then derive how many 800 lm downlights or what luminous-flux ceiling light to choose.
map.书房 / 厨房需更高照度（500 / 750 lux），层高 2.8m、CU=0: Study / kitchen need higher illuminance (500 / 750 lux); at ceiling height 2.8 m, CU=0.6, MF=0.8, recompute fixture count.
map.办公室开放式工位用 500 lux 校核，确认灯具排布均匀、工作台面无暗区。: Open-plan office workstations use 500 lux to verify even fixture layout and no dark zones on work surfaces.
map.面积 5×4=20㎡，总光通量 = 面积 × 照度标准 ÷ (CU × MF): Area 5×4=20 m², total luminous flux = area × illuminance standard ÷ (CU × MF) = 20×300÷(0.6×0.8)=20×300÷0.48=12500 lm. If a single lamp is 800 lm, need 12500÷800≈15.6→round up 16; or choose 2 ceiling lights of 6000 lm each to cover.
map.CU / MF 是什么、怎么取？: What are CU / MF and how to set them?
map.利用系数 CU 是光到工作面的比例（家居 0.4–0.8，浅色吊顶取高值），维护: Utilization factor CU is the ratio of light reaching the work plane (home 0.4-0.8, light-colored ceiling takes the high value); maintenance factor MF is dust attenuation (0.7-0.9). Multiply them as denominator; the smaller, the more lamps needed.
map.参考 GB 50034：客厅 / 餐厅 100–300、厨房 / 书房 300–: Reference GB 50034: living/dining 100-300, kitchen/study 300-750, bathroom 100-200 lux. The finer the activity, the higher; this tool has built-in illuminance tables per room, or manual override.
